ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels; global contrast is very low with high-intensity (white) pixels limited primarily to specular highlights from water and minor surface mottling, estimated at less than 5% of total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes; localized clusters of low-contrast greyish pixels (mottling) observed on the mid-medial region of the left lobe; high-intensity specular highlights concentrated along the lower boundary adjacent to the water spray.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with acute interior angle (approximately 45-60 degrees) and significant bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography; left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, smooth-wave serrations; right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys with a distinct deep notch near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the proximal trailing edge transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (likely rake marks) visible on the mid-medial surfaces of both the left and right lobes, characterized by slight variations in low-intensity grey tones.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch/traumatic loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip, creating a jagged profile compared to the smoother left tip.
